source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U24: Distinguish sale,mortgage and authority over the transferable interest

payload.title: Identify the interest before accepting the security
payload.core_explanation_md:
A sale transfers ownership for the described price consideration. A mortgage transfers an interest in specific immovable property to secure the monetary obligation. A lease transfers the right of enjoyment under its own terms. These are different interests; a person cannot supply a greater interest simply by calling a document a title deed.

Check capacity,ownership or valid disposal authority,and the extent of the interest. A co-owner,lessee,guardian or representative requires the relevant title,consent and statutory analysis. A company also needs the applicable corporate authority. Registration,stamping,encumbrance and local-law checks must be reconciled for the transaction rather than assumed from physical possession of a document.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a lessee automatically mortgage the lessor entire ownership?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Identify the lessee interest and the permitted security.

payload.stem_md: A borrower holds only a leasehold interest but offers the property as if they own the freehold. Which issue is decisive?

options.explanation_md: Value does not establish the interest owned.

options.text_md: The extent and transferability of the borrower actual interest
options.explanation_md: Security cannot be assessed by value alone.

options.text_md: The age of the borrower account
options.explanation_md: Account history does not create freehold title.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Security cannot be assessed by value alone.

payload.stem_md: A company representative holds original deeds and claims that possession alone authorises a mortgage. What remains necessary?

options.text_md: No authority check if deeds are original
options.explanation_md: Possession is not unlimited disposal authority.

options.text_md: Assume the representative owns the land

options.explanation_md: The entity and representative powers must be established.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The entity and representative powers must be established.
